assessment_controller.enforcement: Pre-flight license reservation checks feature authorization, target count limits, and active concurrency limits. Failed, cancelled, or aborted runs release reservations without consuming quota. Terminal completions (COMPLETED or COMPLETED_WITH_ERRORS) atomically commit billable usage to the durable ledger.

cpaas_scheduler.enforcement: Validates entitlement for commercial.cpaas feature before executing scheduled assessments or webhook triggers. Fails closed with licensing refusal under Community tier.

due_diligence_engine.enforcement: Validates entitlement for report.due_diligence feature before running external reconnaissance, financial debt estimation, or executive acquisition dossier synthesis. Fails closed under Community tier.

cli_commands.subcommands: felix license install <path>, felix license status, felix license export-usage [--out <file>], felix license verify-export <file>
cli_commands.enforcement: CLI root entry point routes felix license commands to operator tools for license activation, quota monitoring, and offline usage audit reconciliation.

safe_dev_test_mode.behavior: Detected via test binary context (.test.exe) or explicit secret token; strictly fails closed in production builds if license is missing or feature is unentitled.

usage_signing_key_lifecycle_and_trust_mo.key_generation: Generated per deployment instance using Ed25519 (RFC 8032)
usage_signing_key_lifecycle_and_trust_mo.private_key_storage: Stored strictly in customer private key store with 0600 file permissions; NEVER serialized into usage export bundles or network payloads
usage_signing_key_lifecycle_and_trust_mo.public_key_registration: SignerPublicKeyHex embedded in export and validated against independent LicenseKeyRegistry
usage_signing_key_lifecycle_and_trust_mo.independent_trust_model: VerifyUsageExport requires independent LicenseKeyRegistry or explicit trusted ed25519.PublicKey; NEVER trusts an embedded key as a self-signed root of trust
usage_signing_key_lifecycle_and_trust_mo.key_revocation_support: Registry tracks key status; revoked keys fail closed with ErrRevokedSigningKey
usage_signing_key_lifecycle_and_trust_mo.key_substitution_defense: Mismatches between embedded SignerPublicKeyHex and registry key fail closed with ErrKeySubstitutionDetected
usage_signing_key_lifecycle_and_trust_mo.untrusted_key_defense: Unknown key IDs fail closed with ErrUntrustedSigningKey

multi_signal_detection.sqlite_ledger_monotonicity: Strictly monotonic sequence numbers and monotonically advancing commit timestamps
multi_signal_detection.out_of_band_disk_anchor: Isolated anchor file recording timestamp, sequence, and record digest
multi_signal_detection.filesystem_modtime_sync: os.Chtimes synchronizes anchor file modification time with commit time; future modtimes trigger ErrClockRollbackDetected
multi_signal_detection.restored_snapshot_defense: Anchor sequence exceeding database sequence triggers ErrSnapshotRollbackDetected

threat_model_offline_rollback_and_snapsh.offline_airgap_boundary_limitation: Software-level multi-signal anchor detection halts on OS clock tampering, NTP rollbacks, database replacement, and local filesystem manipulation. However, on pure offline/air-gapped systems without hardware TPM 2.0, secure enclaves, or hardware monotonic counters, full hypervisor VM snapshot rollback (where CPU registers, memory, OS clock, and virtual disk are reverted simultaneously) cannot be detected purely by user-space software. In hardware-enforced environments, TPM NVRAM monotonic counters provide absolute hypervisor rollback prevention.

usage_accounting_crash_safety_and_quota_.uncompleted_operations: Pre-flight rejected, failed, aborted, or cancelled assessments release execution reservations without consuming quota (0 consumed, 0 ledger records)
usage_accounting_crash_safety_and_quota_.crash_during_reservation: In-memory transient reservations vanish on process crash; database ledger remains intact and consistent
usage_accounting_crash_safety_and_quota_.crash_during_durable_write: Atomic SQLite WAL transactions guarantee all-or-nothing ledger commits; PRAGMA integrity_check passes
usage_accounting_crash_safety_and_quota_.duplicate_submission_defense: Repeated commits of the same operation fail closed with ErrDuplicateUsageSubmission or ErrReservationNotFound
usage_accounting_crash_safety_and_quota_.replay_defense: Replaying committed operation IDs in new reservations fails closed with ErrReplayDetected

boundary_validations.integer_overflow: Quota arithmetic overflow checked against math.MaxInt64; rejected with ErrIntegerOverflow
boundary_validations.final_quota_contention: Contention race for last remaining quota unit guarantees exactly 1 winner; concurrent requests receive ErrUsageQuotaExhausted

cryptographic_architecture.canonical_encoding: Canonical JSON (sorted keys, unescaped HTML, compact UTF-8)
